title: AppSpec
description: Schema v7-arc — App Spec: the canonical, shareable recipe for an app. See docs/spec-manifest-v7-2026-05-20.md §3.

spec_id.description: Stable Spec identifier. Persists across versions. Prefix 'p-' is legacy from 'package'; functional meaning is 'spec'.

app_id.description: AL-1.4a canonical identity. For a Spec this IS spec_id (design §3: spec_id == app_id). Written through the canonical-slug gate, so a non-conforming spec_id leaves it absent rather than minting a different id than the gallery path and provenance.spec_id already use.

description.description: Operator-authored summary. Shown on app cards/tiles. Preserved from v13 by migration when present.

app_version.description: App's own semver, distinct from spec_version.

source.description: Set on share. Absent for locally-original Specs that haven't been shared.

sub_objectives.description: Flat list. v1 uses flat structure; hierarchical may be added as a sibling field if forced.

observable.description: Quantitative success metrics (signal references, counts, rates).

observable_outcomes.description: v13-compat alias for observable; preserved through migration so existing operator-authored content isn't lost.

failure_signals.description: Conditions that indicate the app is broken or degraded. Preserved from v13.

minimum_bar.description: The lowest level of functionality the app must meet. Preserved from v13.

identity.description: Preserved-from-v13 block. Holds purpose / scope_includes / scope_excludes / user fields the operator authored. v7's `objective` block is the canonical replacement, but until UIs and downstream consumers migrate, the identity block is the safest place for richer prose.

constraints.description: Preserved-from-v13. Operator-authored safety / dependency / boundary prose. The `privacy` sub-block is canonicalized into top-level `privacy` (Atlas Gap 3); the rest passes through verbatim — 78% of real v13 manifests populate non-privacy fields here, so silent drop would lose meaningful operator content.

test_cases.description: Preserved-from-v13. Operator-authored test triggers + expected behaviors. 76% of real v13 manifests populate this; no clean v7 home yet, so passthrough keeps the content addressable until a richer test-records design lands.

example_triggers.description: Preserved-from-v13. Operator-curated example phrases that should activate the app. 76% populated in real v13 manifests; useful as Forge-time reference + operator documentation.

owner.description: Preserved-from-v13. The bot account that owns/runs the app — usually equals provenance.source_bot_id but operators sometimes set it explicitly.

inputs.description: Preserved-from-v13. App input port / data-source declarations the operator authored.

outputs.description: Preserved-from-v13. App output port / channel declarations the operator authored.

scheduled_actions.description: Preserved-from-v13 (schema v13 extraction). Structured records of recurring behaviors with trigger evidence anchors. Tier-2 audit assertions read these — keep the content addressable.

logical_name.description: Identifier used to reference this file from event_triggers, schedules, etc.

role.description: vital_to_blueprint = Forge MUST recreate equivalent functionality; instance_specific = empty placeholder; reference_only = documentation only.

intent.description: Natural-language description of what this file accomplishes. Authoritative; the snippet is illustrative.

code_snippet.description: Optional reference implementation. Receiving LLM may implement identically, similarly, or differently.

event_triggers.description: Chat-message → handler invocation pairs. Phase 2 of the agent-freelance-bypass spec (docs/spec-agent-freelance-bypass-phase2-2026-06-06.md) extended this with the 'match' shape lock + new 'invocation' sub-object so the same record drives the audit Signal producer AND the plugin's before_prompt_build interceptor.

id.description: Stable identifier unique within the manifest. Surfaces in audit Signal bodies + telemetry.

source.description: Integration channel that produces the event (e.g., 'telegram').

match.description: Pattern matching contract. The trigger fires when channel matches AND pattern matches AND (exclude_pattern is null OR doesn't match).

channel.description: Lowercased channel kind. 'any' matches every channel — use sparingly.

pattern.description: Python-style regex. If re.search(pattern, message_text) matches, the trigger fires. Compiled at manifest load; broken patterns fail validation.

exclude_pattern.description: When set and re.search matches, the trigger does NOT fire even if pattern would. Useful for excluding slash commands (e.g. /optout) from a broad DM catch-all.

audience.description: Role from audience_scoping.role_capabilities that's authorized to trigger.

invokes.description: logical_name of the blueprint file to invoke. Validator confirms it refers to the same file as invocation.script.

invocation.description: Script execution contract. Required when the parent manifest's invocation_mode is 'plugin_intercept'.

script.description: Path to the script under the bot's workspace/scripts/. Forge install pipeline already places these.

request_file_template.description: Path template the plugin writes the request JSON to. Substitutions: {message_id}, {from_id}, {chat_id}. Matches the PR #2192 JSON-request-file invocation pattern.

request_payload.description: JSON shape written to request_file_template. String values may carry {message_id}, {from_id}, {chat_id}, {chat_type}, {message_text}, {message_text_minus_mention}, {message_text_minus_command} placeholders.

stdout_protocol.description: Names the script's stdout protocol. Each protocol's parser is registered in plugin code (packages/plugin/src/observer/triggerProtocols.ts) — adding a new protocol requires a code change. 'raw_text' is the generic protocol forge stamps onto newly built script-backed apps (script prints its reply to stdout, exits 0; errors → stderr + non-zero exit).

on_failure.description: What to do when the script exits non-zero or emits unparseable output. fallback_text is required when 'post_fallback'.

fallback_text.description: Reply posted on failure when on_failure is 'post_fallback'. Verbatim — no LLM rewording.

invocation_mode.description: Which enforcement layer this manifest opts into for chat-routed handlers. 'agent_invokes' (default) = LLM reads bot_guidance prose and invokes via tool use. 'plugin_intercept' = TurnObserver runs the script via before_prompt_build and stays the LLM quiet; requires event_triggers[*].invocation. 'subagent' = reserved for deferred Layer B.

cron_default.description: Default cron line; Instance may override per local time zone.

invokes.description: logical_name of the blueprint file to invoke.

section.description: Markdown heading where this guidance is spliced into the bot's AGENTS.md.

shareable_in_lessons.description: Gates whether observations from this app may appear in shareable Lessons artifacts.

operator.description: Top-level audience class for the app.

approved_surfaces.description: Allowed surface IDs (e.g., 'telegram_dm', 'slack_channel'). Vocabulary is open in v1.

role_capabilities.description: Role name → capability list. Role names and capability vocabulary are open in v1.

operator_bypasses.description: Bypass identifiers permitting operator overrides. Vocabulary is open in v1.

provided_capabilities.description: Schema v29. App-declared capabilities — the app-declared half of the Layer-2 per-role tool-loading model (docs/spec-user-roster-and-roles-2026-06-07.md §4/§8). Optional; absent/empty means 'not yet declared'. Enforcement is a separate later build step; this is schema + validation only.

name.description: Capability id, e.g. 'app.archive.add'. Vocabulary is open in v1.

description.description: One-line human description of the capability.

requires_mcp_tools.description: MCP tools this capability requires loaded — the link into the gateway tool allowlist (Layer 2). Tool vocabulary is open in v1.

default_role_binding.description: Suggested initial role binding when the app installs; admin can override. Null/absent = unbound by default.

approval_audience.description: Which user type approves changes proposed for this app.

seeded_from_pkg_version.description: Builtin tier only. The repo gallery package's pkg_version this Spec was last seeded from, stamped by migrate_v7.migrate_gallery_package. The deploy-time re-seed (reseed_builtin_specs) compares it against the live repo package to detect a bumped gallery package and propagate it to the bound builtin Spec.

seeded_from_pkg_sha256.description: Builtin tier only. SHA-256 of the canonical repo gallery package content this Spec was seeded from. Lets the re-seed catch a same-pkg_version source edit (content drift without a version bump).

required.description: Required deps fail install if missing; optional deps allow graceful degradation.

purpose.description: Natural-language reason for this dependency. Shown to operator when prompting for resolution.

version.description: PEP 440 version constraint; host_check must verify version itself.

host_check.description: Shell command run at install time; exit 0 = satisfied.

scopes.description: Required scopes/permissions on the integration channel.

name.description: Env var or secret-store key name.
